title: Google Places
description: Text and nearby place search over the Google Places API v1. Attach to a route whose upstream is https://places.googleapis.com and whose credential is a Google Maps Platform API key sent as the X-Goog-Api-Key header.
instructions:
Two ways in. search_places takes a phrase and is what you want when the user named something ('ramen in Shinjuku'). search_nearby takes a coordinate and a radius and is what you want when the user said 'near me' or named a point you have already geocoded.

Both are billed by the fields requested, so the field mask is fixed to what these tools read: name, address, rating, price level, opening state, coordinates, and the Maps link. Nothing here returns photos or reviews.

Place types for search_nearby are the Places API's own table values, lowercase with underscores: restaurant, cafe, pharmacy, supermarket, train_station. Pass several to widen the net.

Always hand the user googleMapsUri as a clickable link rather than describing where a place is.

tools.name: search_places
tools.title: Search places by phrase
tools.description: Finds places matching a text query, ranked by relevance. Returns names, addresses, ratings, opening state, coordinates, and a Maps link. Use this whenever the user described what they want in words.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'vegetarian restaurant near Marienplatz Munich'.

maxResults.description: How many to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to the API's own limit.

openNow.description: True to return only places open at the moment of the call.

languageCode.description: BCP-47 code for the result text, e.g. 'de' or 'en-GB'.

tools.name: search_nearby
tools.title: Search places around a point
tools.description: Finds places within a radius of a coordinate, optionally filtered by type. Use this for 'near me' once you have a coordinate, or after geocoding an address. Returns the same fields as search_places.

radius.description: Metres, up to 50000. Start small: a 5 km radius in a city returns noise.

includedTypes.description: Places API type values, e.g. ['restaurant','cafe']. Omit for all types.

prompts.name: somewhere_to_eat
prompts.title: Find somewhere to eat
prompts.description: Search, filter by what is open, and propose three.

messages.content: Find somewhere to eat in {area}, weighted towards {preference} where that is given. Use search_places with openNow true, then propose three with a sentence each on why, their rating, and their Maps link. Say plainly if nothing is open rather than listing closed places.
